newsitem.title: INDIA: India sugar up, demand seen from soft drinks trade.
newsitem.headline: India sugar up, demand seen from soft drinks trade.

text.p: Indian sugar prices on Monday rose on increased consumer buying and demand seen in the soft drinks industry, dealers said.
"Hot temperatures are gaining momentum and we are expecting increased buying by bulk consumers particularly from the soft drinks industry," a dealer said.
In the ready delivery, sugar S-30 rose by 5/25 rupees to 1,270/1,300 rupees per quintal while M-30 rose by 10/20 rupees to 1,295/1,360 rupees per quintal.
Sugar mill delivery moved up by 10/20 rupees to 1,210/1,230 rupees per quintal on the back of higher outstation demand at the mill level.

"There is no major change announced by the finance minister in the budget as far as the sugar trade and industry are concerned. Earlier excise duty on sugar was 85 rupees per quintal and this has been kept unchanged," one broker said.
